name: Vek vampirov: Istorija ljubvi
source:
Discover all the mystical secrets

Find your true love

Make choices that are closer to you

You will play as a character of the Victorian age. Mysticism and romanticism are everywhere. Palaces, dances, intrigues and love are already waiting for you. Choose own way and go through the entire story!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240106083701/https://stacystorygames.itch.io/age-of-the-vampire-love-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
发现所有神秘的秘密

找到你的真爱

做出更贴近你的选择

你将扮演维多利亚时代的角色。神秘主义和浪漫主义无处不在。宫殿、舞蹈、阴谋和爱情已经在等着你了。选择自己的方式并完成整个故事！

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240106083701/https://stacystorygames.itch.io/age-of-the-vampire-love-story]Itch.io[/url]]
